test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word segment in the following sentence.

The girl __which is wearing a blue shirt__ is my sister.

options.text: who is wearing a blue shirt
which is wearing the blue shirt

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the word "**which**" instead of "**who**."
 
• When referring to people,** "who" **is the correct relative pronoun.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**who is wearing a blue shirt**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The girl **who is wearing a blue shirt** is my sister."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "which wear a blue shirt"** – This option is incorrect because "which" should not be used for people, and the verb form "wear" is incorrect.
 
• **Option 3: "who wear a blue shirt"** – This option is incorrect because the verb form "wear" does not agree with the singular subject "girl."
 
• **Option 4: "which is wearing the blue shirt"** – This option is incorrect because "which" should not be used for people.
